svg.title: A production readiness review checks five dimensions before go-live
svg.desc: A production readiness review checks reliability, observability, security, cost, and operational ownership before a pipeline is approved to go live.
svg.text: Five checks, all required, before a pipeline is approved to go live
Reliability — SLOs defined, retries and idempotency verified
Observability — dashboards, alerts, lineage wired up
Security — secrets and identity reviewed, least privilege
Cost — right-sized, tiered storage, no idle spend
Operational ownership — named owner, on-call, runbook
A gap in any one dimension holds the release until it is closed.
